name: Brauhaus-Garmisch
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Brauhaus-Garmisch in Tirol**

Discover authentic Bavarian and Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**, where tradition meets modern comfort. Our historic **Brauhaus** invites you to savor delicious **Schweinshaxe**, hearty **Käsespätzle**, and the legendary **Kaiserschmarrn**—all paired with our own craft beers brewed in-house.

After a day of hiking in the **Zugspitze** region or skiing on the slopes of **Garmisch**, unwind in our cozy tavern. Enjoy live music, local specialties, and a warm atmosphere that makes every visit unforgettable.

**Brauhaus-Garmisch**—where **Tirol**’s charm and Bavarian warmth come together. **Prost!**
